item.title: Mikawa Bay and Laguna Ten Bosch: Aichi's Seaside Playground — Guide
item.description: Mikawa Bay is Aichi’s sheltered inland sea, its calm waters and mild shores long developed as the prefecture’s seaside playground around the resort town of Gamagori. The bay’s landmark is Takeshima, a tiny sacred islet crowned with a shrine and linked to the shore by a 387-metre footbridge, while the modern draw is Laguna Ten Bosch, a waterfront leisure complex whose theme-park zone mixes summer pools, rides, some of central Japan’s most lavish winter illuminations and a festival marketplace of shops and restaurants, making the area an easy family day out of Nagoya.
